# KeepThread

> KeepThread is a 100% local Chrome, Microsoft Edge & Firefox extension that exports and incrementally syncs conversations from 8 AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini & AI Studio, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi, and GLM) directly into your local Obsidian Vault and clean Markdown—without cloud servers, duplicate files, or overwriting handwritten notes.

Publisher: Hangzhou Jianlan Zhiwei Technology Co., Ltd.
Website: https://keepthread.jianlanzhiwei.com/
Changelog: https://keepthread.jianlanzhiwei.com/changelog.html
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mgoimbdbkbfkkobhbbfflmhjklfppkaf
Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/egenkjkggankklhmildnhiccfgjepani
Firefox Add-ons (AMO): https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/keepthread-sync-chatgpt-claude/ (v1.4.4 awaiting review)
Support: support@jianlanzhiwei.com
Latest Release: v1.4.4 (adds 1-click Capture Open AI Tabs, Bulk Sync live progress & Retry Failed, per-note default #tag deselection, Perplexity Reasoning callouts, DeepSeek think-header cleanup, multi-line <br>/<div> code & standalone MathML fidelity, and virtualized pre-export confirmation; v1.4.3 live on Chrome Web Store; v1.4.4 in review across Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Edge Add-ons, and Firefox AMO)

## Key Facts
- **8-in-1 AI Platform Support (`v1.4.4`):**
  - **ChatGPT** (`chatgpt.com`, `chat.openai.com` — supports modern & classic mixed DOM turns, multi-line `<br>`/`<div>` code cards, KaTeX & standalone MathML, GFM tables, citations & attachments)
  - **Claude** (`claude.ai`, `www.claude.ai` — isolates Extended Thinking into collapsible callouts, preserves button-wrapped & multi-span Artifact titles, extracts standalone `/artifact/*` pages and open Artifact side-panel source, strips pure Tailwind code-block headers, turn-scoped web-search citations, clickable images & attachments)
  - **Google Gemini & AI Studio** (`gemini.google.com`, `aistudio.google.com` — Deep Research & Thinking panels, strips hidden screen-reader labels, inline citations & `## Sources`, share links & attachments)
  - **Perplexity** (`perplexity.ai`, `www.perplexity.ai` — `/session/` and `/search/`, extracts Reasoning / Pro Search blocks into collapsible `> [!note]- Thinking Process` callouts with strict citation isolation when `Thinking: Off`, and unifies inline & source-card citations into turn-scoped Markdown footnotes and `## Sources`)
  - **DeepSeek** (`chat.deepseek.com` — converts DeepSeek-R1 reasoning blocks into Obsidian collapsible callouts `> [!note]- Thinking Process` while stripping `Thought for Xs` / `已深度思考` headers, preserves search citations, `/share/` links & attachments)
  - **Grok** (`grok.com`, `www.grok.com` — user/assistant turns, code cards, reasoning callouts, citations & `## Sources`, percent-encoded `/share/` links & KaTeX)
  - **Kimi** (`kimi.com`, `www.kimi.com`, `kimi.moonshot.cn` — merges split sticky-header tables, unified `.rag-tag` citation registry into footnotes, separates `.process-flow` reasoning & images)
  - **GLM** (`chatglm.cn`, `www.chatglm.cn`, `bigmodel.cn`, `www.bigmodel.cn`, `chat.z.ai`, `zchat.z.ai` — strips code line-number gutters, preserves `<eq>`/`<eqn>` KaTeX, separates `.chat-web-think` reasoning & distinct BigModel Trial Center sessions)
- **Lossless In-Place Obsidian Vault Sync & Multi-Vault Isolation:** Connects directly to your local Obsidian Vault folder via the browser File System Access API (`showDirectoryPicker`)—zero Local REST API plugin required. Serializes concurrent writes via Web Locks, Guards persisted handle permissions against browser hangs (`v1.4.3`), updates the exact same `.md` file in-place by `conversation_id` (even with `{date}` filenames), escapes backslashes/multiline YAML cleanly, and preserves handwritten notes (`<!-- keepthread:notes:start/end -->` and trailing notes), custom YAML properties (`status`, `project`, `aliases`), `#tags`, and `[[backlinks]]`. Disambiguates same-named Vault folders on backup migration by on-disk YAML metadata.
- **Inline Rename, Per-Note Default Tag Toggle, Cherry-Pick Only & Thinking Toggle (`v1.4.4`):** Rename notes inline before exporting or syncing (persisting custom titles across re-scans, Bulk Sync, Bulk ZIP, and backups while keeping existing synced file paths intact); click inherited default tags (e.g. `#ai-chat`, `#chatgpt`) to exclude them per note without changing global defaults or wiping Obsidian-only manual tags; select `All`, `Answers Only`, `Last 2`, individual checkboxes, or 1-click `Only` for a single turn; temporarily toggle `Thinking: On/Off` per export; filter by `Needs Sync`; and get automatic safe-length clipboard fallback when an `obsidian://` URI exceeds 16 KB.
- **Free Single-Thread Image-Bundled `.zip` & Firefox MV3 Graceful Export Mode (`v1.4.2+`):** Export a free portable single-note `.zip` bundling clean Markdown plus localized ASCII-hashed images in `assets/keepthread/` (`![[assets/keepthread/...]]`) whenever a conversation contains images or when running on Firefox (where KeepThread automatically adapts Popup, Vault Archive, Guide, and floating pill to `.md`, `.zip`, and `obsidian://` URI without dead folder-picker errors).
- **Anti-Truncation Auto-Scroll Capture, Pre-Export Guard & Code-Immune Formatting (`v1.4.4`):** Built-in Auto-Scroll Full Capture (up to 1,000 steps / 90s per run) recovers off-screen turns on virtualized long chats, warns before exporting partial DOM snapshots on uncaptured virtualized threads, aborts safely on mid-scroll SPA chat switches, and blocks shorter or equal-length shifted scroll windows from overwriting earlier turns. Preserves `<br>` and per-line `<div>`/`<p>` code newlines plus standalone `<math>` MathML formulas, strips bare Tailwind language headers before `<pre>` blocks while preserving real prose, emits a clear Obsidian callout when a Mermaid diagram renders as a source-less SVG, and keeps KaTeX/LaTeX cleanup, Mermaid recovery, footnote remapping, and image localization strictly outside fenced and inline code spans.
- **1-Click Capture Open AI Tabs, Multi-Select Batch Sync (with Retry Failed), Full Obsidian ZIP & Local JSON Backup (`v1.4.4`):** Scan and archive all open supported AI tabs across the browser in one click (zero extra permissions, sleeping-tab fast skip, richer-archive protection). Select multiple conversations for batch sync into your Vault with live `Syncing X/Y` progress and 1-click `Retry Failed` recovery, export a complete Obsidian-ready ZIP archive (case-safe filenames, localized images, `.base` dashboard, custom titles, and scope/tag preservation), and back up or restore your entire local KeepThread IndexedDB archive via portable JSON files.
- **Obsidian Bases (`.base`) Dashboard & Offline Cross-AI Search:** Auto-maintains `AI-Chats/AI-Chats.base` (Obsidian 1.9+ native database view, supporting dynamic `{platform}` folders) and `AI-Chats/_AI-Chats-Index.md` MOC without overwriting handwritten index files. Provides `Cmd+Shift+K` / `Ctrl+Shift+K` 100% local IndexedDB search across all 8 platforms, a draggable corner-snap status pill (`Synced ✓` / `+N new · Update`), and 1-click **Copy Context Prompt** to carry research between AI tools.
- **Verifiable Zero-Cloud Privacy:** No backend server stores your prompts and no `<all_urls>` permission is requested. Outbound requests occur only when downloading referenced conversation images from their original hosts into your local Vault (when local image archiving is enabled) or when voluntarily activating/verifying an optional Pro license key via Dodo Payments.

## Pricing (Anti-Subscription, One-Time Pro)
- **Free Forever ($0, no account required):** Unlimited single-thread clean Markdown downloads & clipboard copies across all 8 AI platforms, custom speaker headings, Full Capture, per-export Thinking toggle, 5 free direct in-place Obsidian Vault syncs, and a 20-thread local offline search archive.
- **Lifetime Pro ($19 one-time Early Bird via Dodo Payments):** Unlimited in-place Obsidian Vault syncs, unlimited local offline cross-platform search (`Cmd+Shift+K`), multi-select Batch Sync to Vault & full Obsidian ZIP export, portable local JSON archive backup/restore, custom folder path, filename & YAML frontmatter templates, and up to 3 device activations that never expire.
